title: Configure basic security headers in default site
objective: Edit the default server block to include security headers like X-Frame-Options and Content-Security-Policy.
rationale: Hardening the default configuration protects against common web vulnerabilities like clickjacking and XSS.
expected_output: The /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default file is updated with security directives.
success_criteria: Headers are present in the response headers when viewed via curl -I.
